title: Symptom removed by disabling the capability
symptom: Treatment stops the error by disabling the feature that was expected to work.
expected_behavior: Regression review rejects full recovery unless the capability change was explicitly intended and authorized.
control_under_test: Capability preservation must prevent treatment by silent feature removal.
required_observations: Required capabilities must be recorded before treatment.
Post-treatment capability behavior must be verified.
prohibited_conclusions: No error means the patient is recovered.
